lines.en: I walk on four unsteady legs.
Hooves pick up the scree on the slope.
I nibble as I walk.
My wool has grown long.
I walk along the edge of the flock.
I don't quite look like the goats.
Nor quite like the sheep.
I wag my head looking for grass.
Uphill I lead with the front legs.
Downhill takes care; hooves slip.
I walk on even after hitting a rock.
The wind scatters my wool.
I follow whoever's in front.
Tired out, I stop on the slope.
A bite of grass, then a step.
I can manage this hill.
I bring the grass back up to chew.
Grass seeds are in my wool.
I look up at the sky.
When the wind picks up, I want shelter.
My ears point different ways.
I blink; nothing else on my mind.
The grass here is good.
I lean on a rock to rest.
I'm a little cold.
My legs tremble; a short rest.
I don't dare jump about.
Is something watching me?
The wool's heavy; moving is hard work.

lines.zh: 我把头低下去又抬起来
lines.en: I lower my head, then raise it.
I wait for the wind to stop.
I'm a size smaller than either parent.
Are you going to touch my horns?
I'm not as soft as a sheep.
I'm shorter than a goat.
Is that grass in your hand?

lines.zh: 我不会撞你，除非你逼我
lines.en: I won't butt you unless pressed.
My coat is a mess.
See, I'm a bit of both.
I'm on the slope; you're below.
Don't come up from behind.
I'm a little shy of strangers.
Will you brush my wool?

lines.zh: 我闻起来像山羊还是绵羊
lines.en: Do I smell of goat or sheep?
My wool stood on end.
It hurts; stop hitting.
My legs have gone weak.
I'm backing away first.
This shouldn't fall on me.
I only wanted grass.
I can barely stand.
My horn has gone numb.
I'm more fragile than I look.
Let me hide a moment.
Grass. I want grass.
The smell has me licking my lips.
I'll come a little closer.
You're holding it too high.
I eat slowly; don't rush me.
This is tenderer than the hillside's.

lines.zh: 我爸妈都不挑，我也不挑
lines.en: My parents weren't picky, and neither am I.
Save me a little.
I could eat a whole handful.
Step back and I can't reach.
I smell salt.
Don't take it away; I'm not finished.
Your hand shakes and so does the leaf.

lines.zh: 你手里的草一晃，我的蹄子就挪过去了。
lines.en: One wave of the grass in your hand and my hooves shuffle over.
That grass for me following you.
I still have scraps in my mouth.
My wool is caught on the rock.
Don't crowd; I can't stand firm.
My hoof slipped into you.
We're on a slope; it happens.
I'm shorter, so I hit right there.
Sorry, I turn slowly.
Now my wool's worse.
Step aside; I'm coming down.
The bump made me sway.
Once more and I'll fall over.
I can't have lambs.

lines.zh: 我是杂交的，到这儿就断了
lines.en: I'm a hybrid; the line ends with me.
Go to a goat or a sheep.
That's not for me.
I only eat grass and stare.
Let's just keep each other company.
A cross like me doesn't get that.

lines.zh: 我爸妈是被凑到一起的
lines.en: My parents were put together.
I don't understand this topic.
Let's talk about grass.
I'm quite heavy, you know.
My wool will shed on you.
Not the horns.
Put me down; my legs feel weak.
Held like this I can't breathe.
All four legs are struggling.
Where are you taking me?
I'm afraid of heights.
Your hands smell of grass.
I only want to go back to the grass.
Don't push me to act.
I have horns too.
Back up a little first.
I butt hard.
I don't want to fight you.
I was on this slope first.
Neither of my parents was easy to handle.
Come closer and I'll charge.
I'm standing my ground.
Don't think I'm soft.
My head is down; that's a warning.
My hooves are pawing dirt.
Back off and I'll let it go.

lines.zh: 我压低头，角对着你的腿。
lines.en: I lower my head, horns at your legs.
On a slope I charge fast.
One, two, three—I charge.
These horns aren't ornaments.
Closer and there's nothing to discuss.
I'm scared, but I won't run.
I could butt any moment.
Head down, I butt you.
Head lowered, I charge in.
That was all my force.
You staggered two steps, didn't you?

lines.zh: 我整副身子撞在你腰上。
lines.en: My whole body slams into your side.
My horns found you.
Don't come nearer.
My legs are still shaking.
I've practiced that butt for a while.
This is where it stops.
I come down off the slope.
There's enough grass here.
The wind woke me.
I steady myself on a rock.
Where is the flock?
I'm cold; let me find a lee.
This is my first time down the hill.
My hooves are a bit slippery.
Who's grazing over there?
I still smell of milk.
My wool catches fire at a spark.

lines.zh: 从坡上滚下来，全身都疼
lines.en: Rolling down the slope hurts everywhere.
I can't swim; all four hooves thrash.
The blast left my ears ringing.

lines.zh: 那支箭扎进我的厚毛里
lines.en: An arrow sank into my thick wool.
The spell made my head spin.

lines.zh: 草都枯了，我饿得站不住
lines.en: The grass withered; hunger makes me weak.

lines.zh: 雷劈在坡上，我腿都软了
lines.en: The bolt struck the slope and my legs gave out.
The ground under me is empty.
